decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

expedite_completion_days_saved.description: Days the expedited laboratory slot saves after the window calendar is reapplied.

The approval does not select an option in advance and does not authorize release_under_certified_config_exception.

facts.rubric: Compared all three alternatives and selected release_after_standard_recert: it is the best currently authorized response that satisfies certification coverage versus the non-displacing cut-in window calendar.
facts.statement: the change meeting needs one defensible cut-in date before the 2026-05-25 build lot; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside certification coverage versus the non-displacing cut-in window calendar.
